children: Australia's One Nation party is celebrating a new electoral victory after its state byelection win in the formerly safe Labor seat of Secret Harbour in Western Australia over the weekend. One Nation's Luke Herdegen claimed the win after voters delivered an 18.6% swing against the Australian Labor Party. While state politics does not always translate into federal voting patterns, the win will nevertheless upset the major parties, which are confronting a significant right wing third force in the country's politics.
